newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 12.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 12.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Tuesday:

On Monday, the Dow Jones industrial average ended up 35.78 points at 6,255.60, eclipsing Friday's record closing high of 6,219.82 points as Wall Street was optimistic U.S. interest rates will keep falling, sending more funds to the stock market.
** On Monday, the Jakarta composite index fell 0.89 points, or 0.15 percent, to 601.13 points after hitting 604.17 points on profit taking in medium and small-capitalised issues.
** Brokers said the market was likely to be mixed on Tuesday on possible continued local-led profit taking and selective foreign buying.
** On Tuesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2334.85/35.35 at 0130 GMT against the opening of 2,334.60/35.10.

** Seasoning producer PT Miwon Indonesia on a report that the firm had raised its annual production capacity to 48,000 tonnes from 36,000 tonnes following a $20-million expansion of its plant in September. Miwon said its planned acquisition of a local printing company was expected to take place this month.
** Tri Polyta on news that its shareholders approved at a meeting on Monday to increase its equity in PT Nisshoku Tripolita Acrylindo.

** Holding company Bakrie Brothers on reports that its telecommunication unit PT Ratelindo posted a 16-percent growth in sales in October. Ratelindo plans to install 280,000 lines in Jakarta and West Java by 1998. Also on reports that the Investment Coordinating Agency (BKPM) will soon issue a permit to Bakrie Motor, the automotive division of Bakrie Brothers, to produce cars.

** Property firm Bhuwanatala said on Tuesday its rights-cum-warrants issue had been approved by shareholders at a meeting on Monday. Bhuwanatala is offering 10 new shares, with one warrant attached, at 5,000 rupiah for every four shares held.
